get.summary: codex events with accepted actions and all source links
get.description: All event types share announce, confirm, progress and amend actions. Updates include persisted confirmations with empty sources, labeled as inferred or manually verified in their titles/summaries. Other actions require at least one source. A minute task creates confirmations for elapsed explicit plans; dates wait for the end of the Beijing day and intervals for their end. Reads do not create actions. Later official evidence updates the same confirmation ID, sources, title, summary and actual time. No confirmation metadata or manual rejection flow is exposed. Each event counts once; dates and intervals do not form precise interval samples.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Inclusive local start date; default start of selected month.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Inclusive local end date; at most six calendar months.

parameters.name: timeZone
parameters.description: IANA time zone; the site uses Asia/Shanghai.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Omit to return all events in range.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor bound to platform, dates, time zone and limit.
